caption: The drawing depicts a decorative, light blue, oval-shaped tin container with a removable lid, both shown separately. The container's surface features a painted pastoral scene, which is visible both on the side of the box and on the lid. The scene includes a central large tree with green and brown foliage, flanked by two large birds with cream-colored bodies and pinkish details. To the left of the tree, there is a church-like building with a tall steeple in light pink and beige tones. In the background, there are green hills, smaller trees, and distant buildings. A group of white horses or cattle is also visible near the horizon. The background sky and land are various shades of blue. The lid of the container has a matching illustration, but the scene is cropped to fit the shape of the lid. The drawing is signed "J. Rothenberg" in the lower left corner of the beige background.
title: Bandbox
